rationale: A is clearer and more concise: parallel lyric slices and line assembly make the verse structure easy to follow, while strings.Join avoids B's more verbose builder and formatting machinery. A also handles an empty verse range gracefully, whereas B can panic when end < start due to a negative slice capacity. Although A's hard-coded bird/spider special case is less general than B's construction, its overall structure has less duplication and needless complexity.
